summary_en: Systena will cancel 42.6 million shares (10.0% of issued shares) on November 12, 2026, and initiate a buyback program to acquire up to 23.8 million shares (6.65% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 10 billion yen over the period from November 5, 2026 to November 4, 2027 through market purchases.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Cancellation of Treasury Stock and Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Systena Corporation announced on November 4, 2026 that it will cancel 42.6 million shares, representing 10.0% of issued shares as of the cancellation date (November 12, 2026), and simultaneously initiate a new share buyback program. The company will acquire up to 23.8 million shares, or 6.65% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum of 10 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over the period from November 5, 2026 to November 4, 2027, using a securities company's discretionary trading method.

The company stated that current market valuations do not adequately reflect its intrinsic earnings power and growth potential, and judged the stock price to be undervalued relative to peer multiples and historical levels. Management indicated it is undertaking this capital initiative while positioning the current fiscal year as a period of focused investment ahead of future growth and maintaining strong conviction in achieving its medium-term operating profit target of 20 billion yen in three years.

The buyback and cancellation are intended to improve capital efficiency through gains in earnings per share and return on equity, enhance shareholder returns, execute flexible capital policies, and address market concerns about shareholder dilution from potential future treasury stock sales.
